caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, repeating floral pattern in red, blue, and black on a light beige background. Large red rose-like flowers appear in the four corners and at the centers of the top and bottom borders, each accompanied by clusters of dark blue leaves below them. In the central area, there is a large blue flower with eight petals, outlined and filled with darker blue dots. Surrounding this central blue flower are smaller star-shaped floral elements in lighter blue, distributed evenly throughout the composition. Tiny black star motives are interspersed in the negative spaces between the main floral motifs. The overall design is framed by a thin double-lined red border with small blue geometric accents in each corner. The whole arrangement appears balanced and methodically structured, emphasizing a horizontal and vertical axis of symmetry.
title: Coverlet
